sources.title: Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model is trained using **Quantization-Aware Training (QAT)**. During training, the weights learn to live in ternary format while being stored in FP16. After training, the `pack.py` script converts them into real ternary weights. The resulting model can then be converted to **ONNX** for production use, or to **GGUF** for Llama.cpp. However, the best runtime performance is currently achieved ...
